seats.file: STATUS.md Observational core; theory/THEORY_RULES.md Observational core

rows.claim: Possibility set. Locked atoms are the shared possibilities, listed once.
rows.why: 35 locks with status LOCK. One list. It is not copied onto the seats.

rows.claim: Three seats over that set. Which seat did the files build?
rows.why: Ψ is built as the mode in the filter. ★Ψ is built as the left side of the wall reading j2=0. Ψ* is declared in the observational core. Ψ★ is the same involution as the left star, not a second operator, so it does not build Ψ*.

rows.claim: Does any file permit the seats to exchange roles with extras=0?
rows.why: The written map is the APS edge ★Ψ = Ψ in the T^{1,1} self-dual sector. That is one pairing. It is not a rotation of the three seats.

rows.claim: Is the joint fixed point ★Ψ = Ψ = Ψ* forced?
rows.why: The observational core declares the joint fixed point. Three seats are not all built, so the binding is not determined with extras=0.

rows.claim: Is a spin, a rotation parameter, or a time coordinate forced?
rows.why: DIMENSIONAL_SCOPE.md leaves t undiscretized. No rotation parameter is a locked atom. The spin of this rotation is unperformed. t is not invented.

rows.claim: A state blocked by the binding but not by the edge.
rows.why: No file exhibits a state the binding blocks and the edge allows. c2 stays a map. Hol(g_C)=SU(3) stays holonomy.

rows.claim: A state the rotation forces that the one pairing does not.
rows.why: The rotation is not an extras-free map. It forces no state beyond the pairing ★Ψ = Ψ.

rows.claim: Has the binding been run on Y^14 → M^4?
rows.why: The observational core says the joint rule has not been run as an asymptotic on-shell boundary condition on Y^14 → M^4. Unperformed is not a disproof.
